notes: 机器人变聪明了，而且更像真人：新增行业选择，选「餐饮」后它自带这一行的常识（过敏原与清真、点菜推荐、订位、外送平台怎么处理、投诉怎么接），资料里没写的不再一句「查不到」就转给你。回复现在会像真人那样分成两三条短消息发出，回复前顾客会看到「正在输入…」。新增门店与菜单管理、「把人工回答教给机器人」、从网址导入本店资料、备用 AI 接口（主接口故障自动顶上）、忘记密码可自助找回。顾客说吃出问题（过敏、中毒、异物、送医）时，系统不经过 AI 直接通知你，并请顾客先就医。修复：顾客发表情或图片不再误转人工导致对话中断；问「你是不是 AI」不再误转人工，而且机器人不会再谎称自己是真人；回复里的星号等符号不再漏给顾客。
notesEn: The bot got smarter, and more human. Pick your industry — choose F&B and it already understands allergens and halal, recommending dishes, reservations, how delivery-platform orders work, and handling complaints, so it stops dumping every unanswered question on you. Replies now arrive as two or three short messages like a real person would send, and customers see "typing…" first. Also new: outlets and menu management, a "teach the bot this answer" button, import-from-URL, a backup AI endpoint that takes over if the main one fails, and self-service password recovery. If a customer reports getting ill (allergy, poisoning, foreign object, hospital), the system alerts you without going through the AI and advises them to see a doctor first. Fixes: an emoji reaction or photo no longer hands the chat to a human and silently ends it; asking "are you an AI?" no longer triggers a handover, and the bot will never claim to be a real person; stray asterisks no longer leak into replies.
